text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. A profile picture *Meet requirements of passport’s profile picture, JPG or TIFF format. * 2. A scanned copy of applicant’s passport’s personal information page * 3. An official certificate of your highest education(or notarized photocopy Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 4. Official transcripts of all high school and college coursework completed. Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. Two letters of recommendation One letter is required from either your school counselor or a teacher from your school. * 6. A personal statement This letter should be no longer than 3 pages in length, double spaced, 12-point font. It should include below content: A summary of your background, creative interests, academic and professional goals; What people/movies/art/events influence you to pursue this field? Why are you applying for this major? Any unusual life experiences you would like to share? * 7. A story outline for an original 5 minute short film * 8. List activities and awards that applicant finds most proud of or can best prove him/herself. 9. A cinematography “reel” of up to one minutes (optional) * 10. Still photographs portfolio of 10-12 images Please limit file size to 15MB or smaller. * 11. Applicants must submit an English proficiency score if English is not the applicant’s native language. The minimum score of TOEFL is 85, the minimum score of IELTS is 6.5. * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -You need to submit results for Mathematics and Humanities Chinese; the Mathematics test can be taken in either Chinese or English. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
